purpose: Bind authoritative 2027 clinical-medicine comprehensive exam geometry without inheriting 2017-2026 structure by assumption.

current_owner_boundary.rule: Historical geometry remains in exam-format.json. This slot owns only future 2027 source identity, validation, delta/invalidation and handoff until an authoritative row is admitted to the historical/current format owner.

arrival_contract.unverifiable_rule: Decision-relevant unverifiable geometry remains UNKNOWN/BLOCKED and cannot silently inherit 2026 values.

comparison_order: compare authoritative 2027 source against 2017-2026 historical baseline
update content/xizong/questions/exam-format.json only after fidelity validation
recompute score/loss envelope and formal-score compatibility
reprice workload only after the new geometry is accepted

review_when_semantics_change: historical calibration band vs Current calibration band
Chat plan or simulation assumptions that depended on old geometry
downstream_invalidation.historical_observation_rule: Old paper scores remain historical observations, but they cannot become Current-format calibration unless their stored exam-format identity matches the accepted Current format identity.

learner_use.before_arrival: Use 2017-2026 geometry only as historical planning prior. Do not claim exact 2027 whole-paper shape.
learner_use.after_arrival: Admit only verified geometry; update whole-paper practice/scoring and X9 calibration as a bounded delta.
learner_use.verification: Run at least one Current-format whole-paper / execution-faithful calibration before using the new geometry for Stage-D certainty.

fallback.late: Continue normal learning on the historical 165/300 planning prior and preserve explicit Current-format uncertainty.
fallback.partial: Bind only verified fields. Missing geometry/scoring/modality fields remain UNKNOWN/BLOCKED.
fallback.second_version: Treat v2 as semantic revision; rerun downstream invalidation before Current authorization.
fallback.never_arrives: Do not invent 2027 geometry. Preserve historical prior only; formal Current-format score extrapolation stays blocked.
fallback.conflicting_sources: Do not choose by convenience. Keep CONFLICT until the authoritative source/version is resolved.

forecast_contract.before_arrival: No Current-format calibration band. Historical observed/calibration evidence may be shown descriptively only.
forecast_contract.after_arrival: Forecast may use Current-format score calibration only when stored paper evidence identity matches the accepted Current format source hash.
forecast_contract.authority: Forecast does not decide format truth or rewrite exam-format.json.
